newsitem.title: USA: Petroecuador seeks change in Oriente price formula.
newsitem.headline: Petroecuador seeks change in Oriente price formula.

text.p: Ecuador's state-owned oil company Petroecuador, under a new administration after the government was deposed earlier this year, has proposed shifting its price formula for Oriente crude back to West Texas Intermediate/Cushing, traders said on Tuesday.
Ecuador had switched its price formula from WTI/Cushing to West Texas Sour/Midland last October in response to the market, they said.
The change would affect customers in the U.S. Gulf Coast, the U.S. East Coast, the Caribbean and South America.
Customers have until Thursday to respond to Petroecuador's proposal.
